scripts.dev:web:external: cd frontend/ibdm && flutter run -d chrome --web-hostname app.ibdm.local.ifri --web-port 8001
scripts.deploy:web: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run deploy:copy-assets
scripts.dev:build:android: cd frontend/ibdm/android && ./gradlew clean build && echo 'Build Done' && echo 'You can start the app now'
scripts.sql_server_db:up: cd backend/config/db && docker compose -f sql_server.yaml up -d
scripts.generate:api-client:prepare: cd backend && pipenv run generate_schema_json && cd .. && copy .\backend\ibdm_api\openapi\openapi.spec.json .\frontend\ibdm\lib\api\ && cd frontend/ibdm && rmdir /S /Q lib\services\api_django
scripts.generate:api-client:build: cd frontend/ibdm && dart run swagger_parser && dart run build_runner build
